verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes dedicated per-model card pages for each release, including the flagship Mistral Large 3, described as an open-weight, general-purpose, flagship multimodal and multilingual model. The pack does not show what those cards contain beyond a one-line capability summary. missing for 10: evidence that the cards document training approach, evaluation results, and intended use, plus independent corroboration of card depth.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can read a published model card or system card — capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use — for the current flagship model

citations.quote: Per-model cards published: the models page links dedicated model-card pages under docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/ for each release
Open-weight, general-purpose, flagship multimodal and multilingual model
